intro: Jamaica is a parliamentary democracy with the British monarch as head of state, though it plans to become a republic.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The prime minister leads the government; Andrew Holness won a third term in 2025. Parliament has an elected House and an appointed Senate.

chapters.title: Becoming a republic
text: Jamaica plans a referendum on removing the monarch.

keyTerms.meaning: A country with an elected head of state.
